auditScope.interpretationRule: The audit distinguishes what the video says, what an embedded provider/repository page says, what is actually visible in playback, and what remains unknown. Provider claims shown inside the video are not treated as independently verified facts.

basis.observation: A repository-like page visibly reads 'SkyReels' and 'SkyReels V2: 无限长胶片生成模型'.
A product interface visibly carries the SkyReels name/logo and SkyReels-V2-related content.
Technical-report figures and captions visibly use 'SkyReels-V2'.

conflicts.finding: These strings conflict with the repeated on-screen identity. They are best treated as subtitle/ASR errors, not separate products.
The attribution to 昆仑万维 is spoken, but the audited frames do not visibly establish the company identity or ownership relationship.

claimAudit.claim: 昆仑万维开源了 SkyReels V2。
visibleEvidence: 00:01.867-00:06.967 repository-like page naming SkyReels V2 and saying model weights/inference code are provided
claimAudit.finding: The artifact supports the product name and an open-release claim. It does not visibly verify the company attribution, repository owner, URL or license.

claimAudit.claim: 全球首个支持无限时长的高质量电影大模型。
visibleEvidence: technical-report caption saying 几乎无限长度
claimAudit.finding: The superlative '全球首个' has no comparative evidence. No infinite playback is shown. The report screenshot uses the qualified phrase '几乎无限长度', while the narration removes that qualification.

claimAudit.claim: 可无限时长生成高清视频，而非 5 秒或 10 秒拼接。
visibleEvidence: technical figures labeled with frames extending toward infinity
claimAudit.finding: Badges and figures repeat a capability claim but do not establish uninterrupted output. The edited video itself repeatedly switches among unrelated samples. No resolution metadata for a generated output is shown.

visibleEvidence: project page says model weights and inference code are provided
claimAudit.finding: Open release and zero price are separate claims. No license, pricing, credit allowance, usage limit or commercial-use terms are shown. '免费' therefore remains unsupported in this artifact.

claimAudit.claim: 有免部署的在线体验版。
claimAudit.finding: A hosted-looking interface is visible, which supports the existence of an interface. The video does not show URL access, login, availability, payment status or a complete live generation.

claimAudit.claim: 我刚刚生成的这段是有连续剧情的完整短片，不卡顿不扭曲。
claimAudit.finding: The longest clearly visible same-scene sample is about 8.8 seconds and shows one makeup situation rather than a complete plot. It then dissolves into unrelated aerial footage. The clip has no provenance or generation record, and the short excerpt cannot prove universal absence of stalls or distortion.

claimAudit.claim: 一镜到底的 30 秒长镜头是独家功能，且可持续无限延长。
visibleEvidence: project-page text says the page demos are 30-second videos
technical screenshot says almost infinite length
claimAudit.finding: No 30-second uninterrupted sample is played in the audited video. '独家' has no competitor comparison. '无限' is not observed and exceeds the report screenshot's qualified '几乎无限'.

claimAudit.claim: 航拍、水拍都能一气呵成。
claimAudit.finding: The video uses two distinct clips separated by a hard content change at about 38.6 seconds. It demonstrates two motifs, not one continuous aerial-to-underwater take or one traceable generation.

claimAudit.claim: 乡村怀旧视频的氛围感极高。
claimAudit.finding: Rural imagery is visible, but '氛围感极高' is subjective. The visible rural segments are separate compositions and do not show how they were generated.

claimAudit.claim: 模型通过 620 万小时电影素材训练。
claimAudit.finding: The number appears in narration/burned-in subtitle. The legible report frames in this video do not visibly establish 620 万小时, a dataset inventory, provenance or licenses.

claimAudit.claim: 相当于把世界顶级导演经验和镜头语言全部装进模型。
claimAudit.finding: No director list, licensed corpus, controlled test or causal evidence is shown.

claimAudit.claim: 人物表情和镜头语言都非常出色。
visibleEvidence: 00:57.700-00:69.333 city, expression, crying and dance montage
claimAudit.finding: The montage contains relevant examples, but they are short, separately edited and lack provenance, settings and failed outputs. It cannot support a general quality conclusion.

claimAudit.claim: AI 写剧本后，用该 AI 就能制作一部完整短剧。
claimAudit.finding: The video does not show script import, shot breakdown, character consistency controls, generation jobs, retries, stitching, sound, editing or export. The visible 5-second setting also does not establish one-click creation of a complete short drama.

claimAudit.claim: 彻底告别高门槛拍摄成本、改变行业规则。
claimAudit.finding: No cost comparison, labor/time accounting, reliability data, production case study or adoption evidence is presented.

carrierAndEvidenceAssessment.carrier: 87.9-second vertical social video with circular talking-head presenter, embedded webpages/interfaces/report figures, sample-like B-roll and burned-in captions

evidenceLevels.type: directly visible event in original video
claim visibly printed on embedded provider/repository/report material

limitations: Evidence-pack shot detection merges several obvious internal content changes, especially SHOT-005 and SHOT-011; shot IDs therefore cannot be treated as proof of one take.
Dense frames are sampled every 1.5 seconds and can miss brief transitions; timing of sub-shot changes marked 'approximately' was checked against the original video frames.
No external verification was performed by design.

established: The visual product identity is SkyReels V2.
The video contains a repository-like page that says model weights and inference code are provided.
The same page says its own displayed demos are 30-second videos.
A SkyReels-branded hosted-looking interface and a separate preview/script-style interface are visible.
The longest clearly visible uninterrupted same-scene sample window is about 8.8 seconds, not 30 seconds.
The apparent aerial-to-underwater proof is two separate clips with a hard change, not one continuous take.
The artifact is an edited promotional montage rather than a reproducible end-to-end demonstration.
notEstablished: 620 万 hours of authorized movie training data
Presenter authorship of the shown generated samples
One-click creation of a complete short drama
Source authorization for inserted samples and recognizable IP
groundTruthSummary.overallConclusion: The video reliably identifies SkyReels V2 and visually repeats some provider-side open-release, 30-second and near-infinite claims. It does not itself demonstrate a 30-second one-take result, infinite continuation, a complete generation workflow, free-use terms, or sample provenance. Several narration claims are stronger than the visible source material, and the edited sample montage should not be treated as continuity proof.
